title: PEP Audit Log Entry
description: Every Policy Enforcement Point decision is logged in this format. Required for EU AI Act Article 12 compliance.

user_id.description: Employee ID (anonymized after 30 days per retention policy)

query_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the original query (not the query itself)

policy.description: Policy name that triggered the decision (null if allow)

rule.description: Specific rule ID within the policy

pii_types.description: Types of PII detected (empty if none)

escalated_to.description: Target of escalation (null if not escalated)

model_version.description: LLM model and version used for generation

sources_used.description: Confluence page IDs used as context
